trials.claim: Includes lifetime access to Trebble Online Audio Editor
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to Trebble Online Audio Editor
trials.reasoning: The binding terms say Trebble may terminate the license at any time, which materially limits the promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: This license shall automatically terminate if you violate any of these restrictions and may be terminated by Trebble.fm Inc. at any time.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access can be terminated at any time by the vendor.

exhibits.quote: use the materials for any commercial purpose, or for any public display (commercial or non-commercial);
exhibits.argument: The license forbids commercial use, limiting podcast creator use despite lifetime access claim.

trials.claim: Includes 120 minutes of audio transcription each month
trials.claimQuote: 120 minutes of audio transcription each month
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms redeeming the deal gave just 120 minutes, matching the claimed 120 minutes per month; complaints about expecting extra or finding the quota strict do not contradict that amount.

exhibits.quote: Also i expected after redeeming the code 120 minutes + 30 minutes free. but it was just 120 minutes.
exhibits.argument: Buyer did not receive 120 minutes plus free minutes, only 120 total.

exhibits.quote: This tool is great, but the Appsumo deal was like offering a spoonful of ice cream—tempting, yet not enough to satisfy, thanks to that strict monthly quota!
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the monthly quota is too strict to be satisfying.

exhibits.quote: Also i expected after redeeming the code 120 minutes + 30 minutes free. but it was just 120 minutes.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the deal provides just 120 minutes of transcription time.

trials.claim: Automatically enhances audio using proprietary sound algorithm
trials.claimQuote: Automatically enhance your audio using our proprietary sound algorithm
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes its AI Vocal Glow enhancement and a buyer confirms enhancing voice and reducing background noise, supporting the enhancement feature despite some users reporting poor sound quality.

exhibits.quote: But the file cuted with trebble sounds bad, like a machine.
exhibits.argument: Enhanced output sounded bad and machine-like instead of improved.

exhibits.quote: My sound was overdriven after uploading and i dont know why (the original file isnt!) therefore its useless for me
exhibits.argument: Uploading degraded sound to overdriven and useless, contradicting enhancement.

exhibits.quote: Trebble’s Vocal Glow feature utilizes advanced AI technology to enhance the quality of speech in your audio and video recordings.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states its Vocal Glow AI technology enhances speech quality in audio recordings.

exhibits.quote: upload a video (mp4), remove filler words and speech anomalies, enhance voice, and remove or minimize background noise
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms Trebble can enhance voice and reduce background noise.

trials.claim: Includes built-in library of license-free music and sound-effects
trials.claimQuote: Get access to a built-in library of license-free music and sound-effects
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists a built-in library of license-free music and sound effects and a catalog of music and sounds; wishing for more afrobeats selections does not deny the library exists.

exhibits.quote: Also wished it had more afrobeats music selections.
exhibits.argument: Buyer found the music library lacking selections.

exhibits.quote: License-free music & SFXBuilt-in library of royalty-free tracks.
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists a built-in library of license-free music and royalty-free tracks on every plan.

exhibits.quote: Our free plan gives you unlimited studio quality recording, unlimited hosting, our Magic Sound Enhancer, our A.I powered noise reduction, our catalog of music and sounds, and more.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states its plan includes a catalog of music and sounds.

trials.claim: Can export a normalized audio file ready for podcast host upload
trials.claimQuote: Export a normalized audio file that is ready to be uploaded to your podcast host
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm Trebble can normalise mics and export edited audio as an mp3, supporting normalized export capability despite isolated reports of failed or truncated outputs.

exhibits.quote: some videos are only 28sec after I had a lot of work to edit it
exhibits.argument: Exported download was truncated to 28 seconds instead of full edit.

exhibits.quote: I uploaded a simple 42-second audio file, and after waiting over two hours, the tool produced nothing—literally zero output.
exhibits.argument: Core audio processing produced zero output, so no exportable file was created.

exhibits.quote: To be able to edit as a word document, remove filler words and silences at the click of a button and remove back ground noise, normalise mics etc... is incredible.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms Trebble can normalise mics and clean audio.

exhibits.quote: While it has more features to explore, I've been satisfied with the basics: upload a video (mp4), remove filler words and speech anomalies, enhance voice, and remove or minimize background noise - plus, if needed, remove or add sections - then export as an mp3 for audio use.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms editing then exporting as an mp3 for audio use works.
